title: How to Read the Crypto Fear and Greed Index (Beginner Guide)
caption: The Fear and Greed Index scores crypto sentiment from zero to one hundred. Here is what it measures and how beginners should use it.

scenes.head: WHAT IS THIS NUMBER?
scenes.narration: You see it everywhere in crypto news: the Fear and Greed Index. What does that number actually mean?

scenes.head: A MOOD SCORE
scenes.narration: It scores crypto market mood from zero to one hundred. Zero is extreme fear. One hundred is extreme greed.

scenes.head: LOW MEANS FEAR
scenes.narration: A reading from zero to twenty four means extreme fear. Investors are nervous and selling.

scenes.head: HIGH MEANS GREED
scenes.narration: Seventy five and above means extreme greed. People are excited, and often buying fast.

scenes.head: WHAT GOES IN
scenes.narration: The score mixes price swings, trading volume, social media activity, Bitcoin dominance, and Google search trends.

scenes.head: HOW TO USE IT
items: It shows mood, not the future
scenes.narration: Remember, it shows mood, not the future. Never rely on one number alone. Always do your own research.
